name: Classical mechanics
description: Newtonian mechanics: forces + acceleration + momentum + energy conservation. Foundation for substrate-relevant dynamics + Hamiltonian formulation + analogues to substrate energy-based optimization.

name: Lagrangian / Hamiltonian mechanics
description: Variational reformulation of classical mechanics: Lagrangian L = T - V (kinetic - potential) + Hamiltonian H = T + V. Foundation for substrate-relevant energy-based models + Hopfield analog.

name: Thermodynamics
description: Laws of energy + entropy + temperature in macroscopic systems. Foundation for statistical mechanics + substrate Glauber dynamics + free-energy minimization analogues.

name: Statistical mechanics
description: Microscopic foundation for thermodynamics: Boltzmann distribution + partition function + free energy. Foundation for substrate Hopfield + Glauber + Boltzmann machines.

name: Electromagnetism (Maxwell)
description: Maxwell equations governing electric + magnetic fields. Foundation for substrate-relevant gauge invariance analogues + signal processing.

name: Quantum mechanics
description: Wavefunction + Schrodinger equation + measurement + Hilbert-space formulation. Foundation for substrate-relevant complex-amplitude representations (FHRR phasor analog) + superposition + measurement collapse.

name: Special relativity
description: Einstein 1905 spacetime invariance + Lorentz transformations + E=mc^2. Foundation for substrate-relevant frame-invariance + symmetry analysis.

name: General relativity
description: Einstein 1915 geometric theory of gravity: Einstein field equations + curved spacetime. Foundation for substrate-relevant curved-manifold analogues.

name: Wave equation
description: Second-order PDE governing wave propagation. Foundation for substrate-relevant oscillator analogues + phase coupling (theta-gamma binding).

name: Thermodynamic entropy
description: S = k_B ln(W) Boltzmann entropy or dS = dQ/T thermodynamic entropy. Foundation for substrate-relevant Shannon entropy connection + 2nd law analog.

name: Neuron action potential
description: Hodgkin-Huxley membrane voltage dynamics: rapid depolarization + repolarization. Foundation for substrate-relevant neural-spike analogues + Hopfield discrete activation.

name: Synaptic plasticity
description: Activity-dependent change in synaptic strength (LTP / LTD / Hebbian). Foundation for substrate-relevant BCM rule + Hebbian learning + biological learning.

name: Hippocampus (memory)
description: Brain region for episodic memory + spatial navigation + pattern separation/completion. Foundation for substrate CLS dual-memory architecture + fast-memory analog.

name: Theta-gamma phase coupling
description: Hippocampal-cortical phase-locked binding: gamma cycles nested in theta cycle code distinct items. Foundation for substrate non-unique role binding (resonator network + Frady-Kent decoder).

name: Prefrontal cortex (PFC)
description: Brain region for top-down attention + working memory + executive function. Foundation for substrate discriminative perceptron analog (top-down attention mechanism) per substrate-as-metacognition memory.

name: Wernicke + Broca language areas
description: Brain regions for language comprehension (Wernicke) + production (Broca). Foundation for substrate-relevant context binding + frame-semantic analogues.

name: Default mode network (DMN)
description: Brain regions active during rest + spontaneous thought + memory consolidation. Foundation for substrate-relevant background-mode analogues + Tier 5 self-discovery brain mechanism.

name: Anterior temporal lobe (ATL)
description: Brain region for semantic memory + person-selective recognition. Foundation for substrate NER frame-semantic entity-type bundle activation per Drill 4.

name: Dopaminergic reward-prediction-error (RPE)
description: Phasic dopamine signals difference between predicted and actual reward. Foundation for substrate methodology rule magnitude calibration per Drill 2 + reinforcement learning.

metadata.substrate_role: methodology rule magnitude calibration brain analogue

name: DNA double helix
description: Watson-Crick 1953 deoxyribonucleic acid structure encoding genetic information. Foundation for biological information theory analogues.

name: Natural selection (Darwin)
description: Differential reproduction based on heritable variation. Foundation for substrate-relevant optimization analogues + Wright-Fisher process.

name: Cell membrane (lipid bilayer)
description: Phospholipid bilayer separating cell interior from exterior. Foundation for cellular biology + selective permeability + signaling.

name: Protein folding
description: Process by which protein assumes 3D structure from amino acid sequence. Foundation for biological function + substrate-relevant optimization landscape analog.

name: Gene expression (transcription + translation)
description: DNA -> mRNA -> protein information flow + regulation. Foundation for biological information processing + substrate-relevant signal cascade analogues.

name: Immune system adaptive recognition
description: Antibody + T-cell adaptive recognition of pathogens via clonal selection. Foundation for substrate-relevant pattern recognition + selection analogues.

name: Predictive coding (neural)
description: Brain as hierarchical prediction machine: top-down predictions + bottom-up error signals. Foundation for substrate-relevant Bayesian inference analog + frame-semantic activation.

name: Hodgkin-Huxley model
description: 1952 ion-channel equations modeling neuronal action potentials via Na+ + K+ + leak conductances. Foundation for biophysically-detailed neural models.

name: Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC)
description: Macroscopic quantum state at near-absolute-zero where bosons occupy lowest quantum state. Foundation for substrate-relevant coherent collective phenomena.

name: Dynamical systems
description: Mathematical framework for time-evolving systems: phase space + flow + fixed points + bifurcations + chaos. Foundation for substrate Hopfield dynamics + Glauber + Wright-Fisher.

name: Circadian oscillator + biological rhythms
description: Endogenous ~24hr biological rhythms via gene expression feedback loops. Foundation for substrate-relevant rhythmic dynamics + phase coupling analogues.
